_whatThisIs: The section headings for an Ayurveda intake module, transcribed from the MediKiosk
There are no questions here, and none will be added by a developer or a model. The
specification is explicit: 'Every module must be approved by qualified practitioners
of that system. An LLM must not invent clinical protocols or select a remedy.'
Prakriti and Vikriti assessment is diagnostic reasoning within a system of medicine;
generating plausible-looking questions for it would produce something that reads as
clinical content, would be indistinguishable from the real thing to a reviewer
skimming it, and would be wrong in ways only a practitioner could detect.
This file exists so the work is scoped, not so it looks done.
_howToUseIt: A qualified BAMS practitioner authors the questions for each section.
A second practitioner reviews them clinically.
A translation reviewer approves each language.
A safety reviewer checks the failure modes.
The result is published through the governance console (Phase 14), which enforces
all four approvals from at least two distinct people before it can go live.
